name: Pinball Arcade: Fireball
storyline: Fireball (1972) is a highly collectable, fantasy themed pinball table that was designed by Ted Zale. This innovative game included ball saving features such as the Flipper-Zipper and a Kickback Kicker in the left outlane. The Flipper-Zipper moves the Flippers to block the center drain and the Kickback Kicker prevents balls from draining down the left Outlane. The middle of the playfield features a Whirlwind Spinner, which sends the ball flying in random directions. Locked ball bonuses and 2 and 3-Ball Multi-Ball put this game way ahead of its time. Fireball is a lightning storm of scoring action! 3,815 units of this table were produced.
